What happens when a robot becomes self-aware… and decides humanity is OBSOLETE?! The terrifying indie horror series Self Aware Robot is packed with murderous machines, hidden messages, and some seriously disturbing AI lore. But today, Theorists, we're uncovering the REAL monster behind this robotic nightmare… and it might not be the robot at all!
